test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which was the first city in the world to have hosted both, the summer and winter editions of the Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Beijing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a 44 to 40 vote, Beijing won the 2022 Winter Olympic Games bid over Almaty, Kazakhstan.
 
• This makes the Beijing capital the first city to host both summer and winter Olympic games.
 
• **Bing Dwen Dwen**, a panda was revealed as a mascot for Beijing Winter Olympics 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Olympics is an international multi-sportings event.
 
• It is held once every four years.
 
• It includes several countries' selected players as participants.
 
• The Olympic logo consists of five rings and one icon of the place where it is held
 
• Blue, yellow, black, green, and red is the order of the color of the Olympic logo rings 
 
• It represents five continents: Asia, Africa, America, Australia, and Europe.
